snippet.title: The Apartment  - Final Trailer [Psychological Thriller Game]
snippet.description:
Psychological Thriller Game - The Apartment
http://store.steampowered.com/app/752020

Game Info:
The Apartment is a small psychological thriller. Bizzare mix of first person detective adventure game, action and psychological horror with some interesting puzzles, all tied together with dark and heavy story

Links:
Twitter: https://twitter.com/AndrewKorecki
